say:1:1521323001:0.text: We've finally reached Wrathwood Grove. Thank you, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Twitch and I couldn't have done it without you.

say:2:1521323002:0.text: We still don't know where our parents are, so we're going to ask some of our acquaintances first. I'm afraid we won't be able to properly thank you with a hot meal today.
say:2:1521323002:0.source_cn: 我们还不知道阿爹阿娘在哪，只能先去找相熟的朋友问问看，...

say:3:1521323003:0.text: However, I believe we'll have a new home here soon.
say:3:1521323003:0.source_cn: 不过，相信很快我们就会有一个新家了。

say:10:1521323007:0.source_cn: 不可以再提那个呼临人！不可以不可以！

say:11:1521323008:0.text: My sister is so beautiful! He doesn't deserve her!
say:11:1521323008:0.source_cn: 我姐姐这么漂亮，他根本配不上我姐姐！

say:12:1521323009:0.text: If it wasn't for us trying to escape, my sister would never give him the time of day! He's just bothering my sister!
say:12:1521323009:0.source_cn: 要不是为了脱离他们的看守，我姐姐才不会给他好脸色呢！都...

say:14:1521323011:0.text: I told you before not to say these things! Especially not in front of Marco!
say:14:1521323011:0.source_cn: 我和你说过了，不许再说这样的话！尤其是不许在马尔科面前说！

say:15:1521323012:0.text: I-I never said this in front of him... but he must think the same thing!
say:15:1521323012:0.source_cn: 我……我没有在他面前说，但他肯定也是这么想的！

say:16:1521323013:0.text: He doesn't deserve you, Fufu! Otherwise, he wouldn't have let you go!
say:16:1521323013:0.source_cn: 姐姐，他一点都配不上你！不然他才不会放你走呢！

say:17:1521323014:0.text: Father always said that if you like someone, you should try your best to be by her side. He didn't do that, so that means he doesn't really like you.
say:17:1521323014:0.source_cn: 阿爹说过，要是喜欢一个人就该拼命对她好，把她留在身边！...

say:20:1521323016:0.text: There was never any real possibility between me and him anyway...
say:20:1521323016:0.source_cn: 反正我和他之间，本来也不可能……

choice_prompt:21:1521323016.text: There was never any real possibility between me and him anyway...

say:22:1521323017:0.text: The hatred between the Wildborn and Halians runs too deep. It won't just disappear.
say:22:1521323017:0.source_cn: 不……雅库伯尔和呼临城之间的仇怨那么深，没办法轻易消解。

say:23:1521323018:0.text: Even if Marco and I tried our best, my parents... I don't know...
say:23:1521323018:0.source_cn: 就算我和马尔科努力争取，但我阿爹阿娘也……
